description: This file defines the PlanarReflection class responsible for rendering planar water reflections in Unity, including camera setup, reflection matrix calculations, and shader keyword toggling.

classes.name: PlanarReflection
classes.description: A Unity MonoBehaviour that manages water surface reflections, including creating reflection cameras, rendering reflections, and shader keyword toggling.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Initializes the shared material from the WaterBase component.

methods.name: CreateReflectionCameraFor
methods.description: Creates or finds a reflection camera associated with the current camera.

methods.name: SetStandardCameraParameter
methods.description: Sets culling mask, background color, and disables the camera.

methods.name: CreateTextureFor
methods.description: Creates a render texture for the reflection camera.

methods.name: RenderHelpCameras
methods.description: Manages helper cameras for reflection rendering.

methods.name: WaterTileBeingRendered
methods.description: Sets the reflection texture on the shared material during water rendering.

methods.name: OnEnable
methods.description: Enables reflection shader keyword, disables simple water shader.

methods.name: OnDisable
methods.description: Disables reflection shader keyword, enables simple water shader.

methods.name: RenderReflectionFor
methods.description: Performs the reflection rendering process, including matrix calculations and camera setup.

methods.name: SaneCameraSettings
methods.description: Configures camera settings for reflection rendering.

methods.name: CalculateObliqueMatrix
methods.description: Calculates the oblique projection matrix for reflection clipping.

methods.name: CalculateReflectionMatrix
methods.description: Calculates the reflection matrix based on a plane.

methods.name: Sgn
methods.description: Returns the sign of a float value.

methods.name: CameraSpacePlane
methods.description: Calculates the camera space plane for reflection clipping.
